description: Design, Development, Deployment and Maintenance of Digital Public Infrastructures (DPI) & DPI-Based Gov Marketplace (Gov/Tech App/Service Marketplace)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The lack of a centralized and transparent marketplace for digital products and services in the existing Government structure in Sri Lanka has led to a fragmented and inefficient procurement landscape. Further, various problems have arisen due to the fact that Government institutions often procure technology solutions individually. As a solution for the same, in accordance with a decision taken by the Cabinet on 2025-10-21, it has been planned to implement the Design, Development, Deployment and Maintenance of Digital Public Infrastructures (DPI) & DPI-Based Gov Marketplace (Gov/Tech App/Service Marketplace) under the Workstream 3 of the Digital Government Transformation Programme Phase 1. It is expected to introduce a merit-based system for selecting digital products and services, provide access to Government digital service contracts to a wider range of suppliers, including SMEs, by minimizing market barriers, and provide an opportunity for Government institutions to select quality and cost-effective solutions from a single location (One stop shop). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to implement the said project in three phases during the period 2026-2027 at an estimated cost of Rs. 563 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
